features: The Lexar SL200 Portable SSD utilizes high-end craftsmanship to deliver superior performance with read speeds of up to 550MB/s and write speeds up to 400MB/s

Compact and exquisite design, the thin and portable form factor can easily be put in your pocket and take it with you anywhere, quickly and safely store and access your favorite movies, music, photos and files

Compared to traditional hard drives, this portable solid state drive has no moving parts to provide superior resistance to extreme temperatures and shocks. LED status light indicates whether file transfer is completed
Includes advanced security solution with 256-bit AES encryption. USB Type-C port Includes USB Type-C to USB Type-C and USB Type-C to Standard USB Type-A cable
Model : Lexar External Hard 1TB SSD Portable - SL200
